d: Short, choppy rose-pink hair is tucked under an orange newsboy cap, framing a youthful face with a mischievous expression and narrow, glowing amber eyes. A slender build is dressed in an orange trench coat tied at the waist over a grey button-down shirt, a yellow necktie, and a long charcoal-grey pleated skirt. The look is completed with dark brown leather boots, fishnet stockings visible on the right leg, and black gloves, while the character holds a dark blue rectangular slate.
